content:
I've been going through the Mathematics in Lean book and everything has been fine so far, but when I try to use autocomplete through Ctrl+Space I don't get anything for some reason.
image.png
On the other hand, the 'quick fixes' button seems to work fine, but doesn't go over all of the options.
image.png
I'm not sure if there's some setting I accidentally turned off since I'm fairly new to VSCode in general, but any help would be great, thanks.

I also have problems with autocomplete on my mac laptop since I installed a second keyboard option; now ctrl-space enables me to change keyboard (which I very rarely want to do) and I've not been able to autocomplete since. On my Ubuntu desktop I get the expected

Screenshot from 2026-03-05 00-44-33.png

Edit: solved my issue by asking ChatCPT. Open keyboard shortcuts (cmd+K cmd+S on a mac, probably ctrl+K ctrl+S on other systems), then search for "Trigger suggest" and check it's bound to ctrl+space. For me it was, but it still wasn't working for some reason (even after disabling the change keyboard thing), so I just bound it to something else and now it works :shrug:
VS Code also binds Ctrl+I to "trigger suggest" by default as well.
